flo_price.q: What does Flo cost in Nigeria?
flo_price.a: If you use Android in Nigeria, Flo's Pass It On Project gives you Premium for one year at no charge from your upgrade date. Google Play also lists Premium at no charge in Nigeria. On iPhone, the lowest price is ₦3,900 (about $3). The highest is ₦29,900 (about $22).

flo.name: Flo
flo.listing_label: Flo on the Nigerian App Store
flo.share: We sampled 3,521 Flo reviews with one to three stars. About half (51%) mention paying, and 18% say features moved behind Premium. In our Nigerian App Store sample, 7 of 22 mention paying. We counted words in small samples.

complaints.t: Too many subscriptions just want a tracking app for dates and symptoms without an extra charge
this would be a really good app except that every time you click on it there are a million pop ups trying to get you to subscribe to the paid version
Why do we have to pay it’s an app for our cycle for girls ladies or women

praise.t: gives pretty accurate predictions and lots of helpful information
Flo helps me stay organised with my cycles; it’s awesome and super educational:) very reliable

flo.note: The Nigerian quote is one woman's experience. On Android in Nigeria, Flo's Pass It On Project gives Premium at no charge for one year. On iPhone, the lowest price is ₦3,900 (about $3). The highest is ₦29,900 (about $22).

clue.name: Clue
clue.share: We sampled 3,500 Clue reviews with one to three stars. About half (49%) mention paying. Another 28% mention ads, mostly pop-ups asking women to upgrade.

complaints.t: It constantly (multiple times per session) pops up trying to get you to buy the subscription.
Can’t use the app without ads for subscription upgrade

praise.t: I’ve been using this app for years now and having my periods recorded in one clear place to refer back to really makes a difference.

pc.name: Period Calendar
pc.listing_label: Period Calendar on the App Store
pc.share: We sampled 2,583 Period Calendar reviews with one to three stars. Ads appeared most at 17%. App problems came next at 11%, then paying at 6%. Another 56% did not match any topic we counted.

complaints.t: Good app, but confusing features and ads. Why are there ads in a period app?
The banner ads at the bottom are fine but having a full-screen ad every time I open the app is incredibly annoying :/
This is a great app for beginners and I enjoyed the info you can place in the app , wish there was no ads though
I can’t seem to log back in with my email for syncing it’s frustrating pls fix it, I honestly don’t like this!😒

praise.t: I love that this app reminds me of my upcoming period and helps me keep track of my cycle.  Although some features are to be unlocked by paying but the much I can access is quite useful and the app is amazing.
I’ve been using this app since 2020, and the experience only gets better
Excellent tracking app, great tips, useful notifications. I completely love love this app
